zh: 交代数据从哪来：一个装着 $N$ 条独立样本的公共池，参数 $\theta$ 在单位立方体里。
全局只有这 $N$ 条数据；同一个编号就是同一条样本，不能当成两份。
en: Sets up the data: a common pool of $N$ i.i.d. samples, with $\theta$ in the unit cube.
There are only $N$ samples; the same index is the same sample, never two copies.

zh: 交代每台机器怎么拿数据：各自独立地从池里不放回取 $m$ 条，抽样设计公开。
机器之间会抽到同一条样本，这种“重叠”是全文的新难点。
en: How machines get data: each draws $m$ items independently without replacement; the design is public.
Machines can draw the same sample — this overlap is the paper’s new difficulty.

zh: 定义随机种子和非交互协议：每台只看自己的数据，各发一条 $k$ 比特消息。
最简单的协议；论文的上界只用它就够了。
en: Defines the seeds and the noninteractive protocol: each machine sends one $k$-bit message from its own data.
The simplest protocol — and enough for the upper bound.

zh: 定义黑板协议：大家轮流写比特、都能看到黑板，谁下一个写只由公开历史决定。
允许交互是最强的设定，下界要对它也成立；记录的熵 $\le B\ln2$ 从这里来。
en: Defines blackboard protocols: machines take turns writing public bits; who speaks next depends only on the public history.
Interaction is the strongest setting, so the lower bound must cover it; transcript entropy $\le B\ln2$ comes from here.

zh: 定义估计量和 minimax 风险，并指出黑板协议的最优误差不超过非交互的。
全文要算的就是 $R_{\mathrm A}(N,m,n)$；只需证 BB 的下界和 NI 的上界。
en: Defines the estimator and the minimax risk, and notes blackboard is at least as good as noninteractive.
The target is $R_{\mathrm A}(N,m,n)$; it suffices to lower-bound BB and upper-bound NI.

zh: 列出下界需要的正则性：有密度、支撑不随参数变、能交换求导与积分。
这些条件保证 score 均值为零，Fisher 信息有意义。
en: Lists the regularity the lower bound needs: densities, fixed support, swapping derivative and integral.
They make the score mean-zero and Fisher information meaningful.
The Bernstein score condition (19) uniformly controls every direction of the score.
It bounds information in each unit direction by $v$ and bounds the full Fisher-information trace by $dv$; later it limits score shifts after learning an event.
zh: Bernstein 得分条件 (19) 对得分的每个方向给出一致控制。
每个单位方向的信息至多为 $v$，Fisher 信息矩阵的迹至多为 $dv$；后面还用它限制得知一个事件后得分均值的偏移。
给出上界的唯一假设 (24)：有 $d$ 个取值在 $[0,1]$ 的矩，能稳定地反推参数。
上界的路线就是“分布式地估矩，再反解参数”。
en: States the upper bound’s only assumption (24): $d$ moments in $[0,1]$ that identify the parameter stably.
The upper bound = estimate moments in a distributed way, then invert.

zh: 说明两组假设分别给谁用：下界用 (19)，上界用 (24)。
两边要同时成立，才能得到“上下界同阶”的结论。
en: Says which side uses which assumption: (19) for the lower bound, (24) for the upper.
Both are needed only when matching the two bounds.

zh: 定义总预算 $B$、余量 $s$ 和比特底线 $a_B$。
$s$ = 每维比特减去“定位到单机精度”要花的 $\tfrac12\log_2 m$；它决定比特是不是瓶颈。
en: Defines the budget $B$, the surplus $s$ and the bit floor $a_B$.
$s$ = bits per coordinate minus the $\tfrac12\log_2 m$ needed to localize; it decides whether bits are the bottleneck.

zh: 定义访问重数 $D_a$、共享观测数 $r$ 和它的期望 $\bar r$。
$\bar r$ 只出现在下界里，正是上下界唯一的差别。
en: Defines the access multiplicity $D_a$, the shared count $r$ and its mean $\bar r$.
$\bar r$ appears only in the lower bound — the only difference between the bounds.

zh: 定义下界包络 $\mathcal L$（地板）和上界包络 $\mathcal U$（天花板），逐项解释四个瓶颈。
四项分别是：池子大小、总访问量、总比特、定位与精修；两者只差第四项里的 $\bar r$。
en: Defines the lower envelope $\mathcal L$ (floor) and upper envelope $\mathcal U$ (ceiling) and explains the four bottlenecks.
Pool size, total accesses, total bits, localization-and-refinement; they differ only by $\bar r$ in the fourth term.

zh: 给出定理 1 和推论 1：在表 I 的五种情形下上下界同阶。
这些情形里问题完全解决，而且交互不能改进误差的量级。
en: States Theorem 1 and Corollary 1: the bounds match in the five regimes of Table I.
In these regimes the problem is solved and interaction cannot improve the rate.

zh: 证明表 I 第 1 行：余量有界。
这时比特是唯一的瓶颈，误差 $\asymp da_B$。
en: Proves row 1 of Table I: bounded surplus.
Bits are the only bottleneck; error $\asymp da_B$.

zh: 证明表 I 第 2 行：余量与 $n$ 成正比。
比特充足，只剩“能看到多少不同样本”这一限制。
en: Proves row 2 of Table I: surplus proportional to $n$.
Bits are plentiful; only the number of distinct samples limits.

zh: 进入临界窗口（$s\to\infty$、$s/n\to0$），化简包络并证明第 3 行（池子小）。
窗口里只剩 $1/N$ 和 $1/(ms)$ 两项；池子小时误差 $\asymp d/N$。
en: Enters the critical window ($s\to\infty$, $s/n\to0$), simplifies the envelopes and proves row 3 (small pool).
Only $1/N$ and $1/(ms)$ remain; with a small pool the error is $\asymp d/N$.

zh: 证明第 4 行：池子很大时，共享样本很少。
$\bar r\lesssim ms$，所以 $\bar r$ 不碍事，误差 $\asymp d/(ms)$。
en: Proves row 4: with a large pool, few samples are shared.
$\bar r\lesssim ms$, so it is harmless; error $\asymp d/(ms)$.

zh: 证明第 5 行：完全重叠（$m=N$）时，所有机器算同一个经验矩。
比特可以“合在一起用”，误差 $\asymp d(1/N+a_B)$；重叠不全是坏事。
en: Proves row 5: under full overlap ($m=N$) all machines compute the same empirical moment.
Bits can be pooled; error $\asymp d(1/N+a_B)$ — overlap is not always bad.

zh: 给出推论 2：多项式耦合与指数速率。
多项式增长全部解决；只有单机数据随 $n$ 指数增长时才可能落进未解决区间。
en: States Corollary 2: polynomial couplings and exponential rates.
All polynomial growth is solved; only exponentially large local data can hit the open window.

zh: 推导得分恒等式：经过与参数无关的处理后，消息的 score 是原始 score 的条件期望。
这是整个下界的地基：压缩只会把信息平均掉。
en: Derives the score identity: after a $\theta$-free processing, the message score is the conditional mean of the raw score.
The foundation of the lower bound: compression only averages information away.

zh: 由条件 Jensen 得到 Fisher 版数据处理不等式，再给出 Fisher 信息的链式法则。
加工不增加信息；联合信息可以拆成两块相加（III-D 靠它单独处理共享数据）。
en: Gets the Fisher data-processing inequality from conditional Jensen, then the chain rule.
Processing adds no information; joint information splits into two parts (III-D uses this for shared data).

zh: 选一个两端为零的平滑先验，算出它的 Fisher 信息和微分熵。
这两个常数分别进入 van Trees 的分母和熵预算。
en: Picks a smooth prior vanishing at the edges and computes its Fisher information and entropy.
These two constants feed the van Trees denominator and the entropy budget.

zh: 用分部积分加 Cauchy–Schwarz 证明 van Trees 不等式。
误差 $\ge d^2$/(平均信息 + 先验信息)：从此“证下界” = “给信息找上界”。
en: Proves the van Trees inequality by integration by parts and Cauchy–Schwarz.
Error $\ge d^2$/(average information + prior information): lower-bounding error = upper-bounding information.
Count how many distinct observations are accessible and apply the information bound to them.
This yields a sample-count lower bound even with unlimited communication; its order is $d/\min\{N,nm\}$, with constants depending on the model.
zh: 先计算实际能访问多少条不同观测，再对它们应用信息上界。
即使通信无限，也会得到由样本数量决定的误差下界，量级为 $d/\min\{N,nm\}$，常数取决于模型。
把误差和互信息联系起来：误差要小，记录就必须传足够多关于 $\Theta$ 的信息。
用的是“给定方差时高斯熵最大”。
en: Links error to mutual information: small error forces the transcript to carry much about $\Theta$.
Uses “the Gaussian maximizes entropy for a given variance”.

zh: $B$ 比特至多传 $B$ 比特信息，得到比特底线；再把记录的熵拆成参数信息和剩余熵 $h_T$。
前三项下界到这里齐了；熵预算 (118) 是 III-E 的关键输入。
en: $B$ bits carry at most $B$ bits, giving the bit floor; then split transcript entropy into parameter information and leftover $h_T$.
The first three lower-bound terms are done; the entropy budget (118) is III-E’s key input.

zh: 引理 1：得知一个概率为 $p$ 的事件，最多能把块 score 推偏多少。
偏移 $\lesssim\sqrt{vq\ln(1/p)}+b\ln(1/p)$：越罕见越有料，但只按对数增长。
en: Lemma 1: how far learning an event of probability $p$ can shift a block score.
Shift $\lesssim\sqrt{vq\ln(1/p)}+b\ln(1/p)$: rarer events say more, but only logarithmically.
Bounds the second moment of transcript surprisal uniformly over alphabets with at most $2^B$ leaves.
The bound is of order $(B+1)^2$, including small $B$; it controls the correction when $b>0$.
zh: 对至多有 $2^B$ 个叶子的记录，统一控制惊讶度二阶矩。
上界为 $(B+1)^2$ 的量级，也覆盖小 $B$；用于控制 $b>0$ 时的修正项。

en: Fixes the complete transcript and all seeds, then factors its event into local checklists.
With independent inputs at fixed parameter, both leaf probabilities and conditional block laws factor.
zh: 固定完整记录与全部种子，再将其事件拆成逐台机器的检查清单。
固定参数且输入独立时，叶子概率与条件块分布都能分解成乘积。

en: Combines posterior block scores, cancels cross terms after averaging, and applies the single-block event bound.
The largest block size scales the entropy term; the tail correction is paid once for the whole transcript.
zh: 合并后验块得分，在平均后消去交叉项，再套用单块事件界。
熵项前使用最大块大小，尾修正只对完整记录计算一次。

en: Averages fixed-seed information and entropy bounds, then repeats with the sharper sub-Gaussian estimate.
The seed law contributes zero Fisher information; the conditional transcript contribution still must be averaged.
zh: 对固定种子下的信息界与熵界平均，再用更紧的次高斯估计重复论证。
种子分布本身的 Fisher 信息为零，条件记录的信息贡献仍须取平均。
把样本分成共享组和各机器的私有组，并陈述定理 2。
共享数据按条数加信息（每条 $\le dv$），私有部分受记录熵限制。
en: Splits samples into a shared group and private groups, and states Theorem 2.
Shared data add information per item ($\le dv$ each); private parts are limited by transcript entropy.
Reveals shared observations only in the Fisher-information comparison, with seeds fixed.
The chain rule accounts separately for shared information; these observations are not free side information in the bit budget.
zh: 固定种子，仅在 Fisher 信息的比较中揭示共享观测。
链式法则单独计入共享信息；不能在比特预算中把共享观测当免费辅助信息。

en: At each fixed parameter, shared value and seed, the remaining inputs are independent private blocks.
The conditional protocol is parameter independent, so Lemma 3 applies. Prior averaging comes later.
zh: 对每个固定参数、共享值与种子，剩余输入为独立私有块。
条件协议的规则不依赖参数，因此可用引理 3；先验平均留到后面。
对共享数据的取值和种子平均，完成定理 2。
再用熵的链式法则把条件熵放宽成更好用的形式 (175)。
en: Averages over the shared data and seeds to finish Theorem 2.
The entropy chain rule then relaxes it to the handier form (175).

zh: 次高斯和高斯情形下的更紧版本。
高斯时常数完全显式。
en: Tighter versions for sub-Gaussian and Gaussian scores.
Constants are fully explicit in the Gaussian case.

zh: 解释共享项：它直接相加、不乘熵；并把抽样设计也平均掉。
下界里的 $\bar r$ 就是在这里进来的；它也是 gap 的来源。
en: Interprets the shared term (added, not multiplied by entropy) and averages over the design.
This is where $\bar r$ enters the lower bound — and the source of the gap.

zh: 把信息界代进 van Trees，再和熵预算合并。
关键时刻：定位花费 $\tfrac12\ln m$ 被抵消，只剩余量 $s$。
en: Plugs the information bound into van Trees and combines it with the entropy budget.
The key moment: the localization cost $\tfrac12\ln m$ cancels, leaving the surplus $s$.
Eliminates remaining entropy and bounds a positive reciprocal-risk variable using $t+\ln t$.
An upper bound on $t$ becomes a lower bound on error; the general result still has a squared-budget correction.
zh: 消去剩余熵，通过 $t+\ln t$ 控制正的风险倒数变量。
$t$ 的上界转成误差下界；一般情形此时仍保留预算平方修正。

en: Removes the squared-budget correction using the regimes $m\ge n^2$ and $m<n^2$.
For fixed dimension and per-machine budget, absorb the correction in the first regime; use the access floor in the second for large $n$.
zh: 分 $m\ge n^2$ 与 $m<n^2$ 两种情形，去掉预算平方修正。
固定维度和单机预算：第一种情形吸收修正；第二种在 $n$ 足够大时使用总访问下界。
高斯均值情形下保留所有常数，用 Lambert W 写出显式下界。
一个完全显式、非渐近的下界。
en: For the Gaussian mean, keeps all constants and writes an explicit bound via Lambert W.
A fully explicit, non-asymptotic lower bound.
Lemma 4 resamples only from a machine’s own subset, yet produces i.i.d. uniform pool indices after averaging over that random subset.
This is an exact distributional identity, not an approximation that assumes overlaps are rare.
zh: 引理 4 只在本机子集内重抽样，但对随机子集平均后，所得编号恰好与从全池独立均匀抽取相同。
这是精确的分布恒等式，不是建立在“重叠很少”假设上的近似。

en: Condition on the whole sample pool while leaving access sets and private resampling randomness random.
The resampled observations are then i.i.d. from the empirical pool law, allowing independent-input encoders to be used conditionally.
zh: 固定整个样本池，但仍保留访问集与私有重抽样随机性。
此时重抽样观测独立同分布于池的经验分布，因此可以在这一条件实验中使用要求独立输入的编码器。
把有界矩随机化成伯努利硬币，每台的正面计数服从二项分布。
问题变成：分布式地估 $d$ 个伯努利参数。
en: Randomizes bounded moments into Bernoulli coins; each machine’s head count is Binomial.
The problem becomes distributed estimation of $d$ Bernoulli parameters.

zh: 算经验矩的池子误差，并把总误差拆成通信误差 + 池子误差。
池子误差 $\le d/(4N)$ 是固定的，后面只需控制通信误差。
en: Computes the pool error and splits total error into communication + pool.
The pool error $\le d/(4N)$ is fixed; only communication error remains.

zh: 引入外部工具：Cai–Wei 的稳健标量编码保证。
只要输入近似高斯、次高斯，就能达到“样本、比特、精修”三项最大值。
en: Brings in the external tool: the Cai–Wei robust scalar encoding guarantee.
Near-Gaussian, sub-Gaussian inputs achieve the max of the sample, bit and refinement terms.

zh: 构造平滑统计量：样本均值加一点补齐方差的高斯噪声。
让离散的二项计数变得像高斯，满足编码保证的输入条件（引理 5）。
en: Builds the smoothed statistic: the sample mean plus Gaussian noise topping up the variance.
Makes the discrete binomial look Gaussian, meeting the encoder’s input condition (Lemma 5).

zh: 验证平滑统计量无偏、次高斯。
编码保证的两个条件之一。
en: Checks that the smoothed statistic is unbiased and sub-Gaussian.
One of the encoder’s two conditions.

zh: 用高斯模糊把任意有界测试函数变光滑，并控制它的三阶导数。
为下一步的 Lindeberg 替换做准备。
en: Smooths any bounded test function with a Gaussian and bounds its third derivative.
Prepares the Lindeberg replacement.

zh: Lindeberg 替换：把伯努利项逐个换成同均值、同方差的高斯。
每换一个误差约 $q^{-3/2}$，总共 $\lesssim q^{-1/2}$：统计量接近高斯。
en: Lindeberg replacement: swap Bernoulli terms one by one for Gaussians with the same mean and variance.
Each swap costs ≈ $q^{-3/2}$, total $\lesssim q^{-1/2}$: the statistic is near Gaussian.

zh: 修正剩余的方差不匹配，用 Pinsker 不等式控制。
TV 距离 $\lesssim q^{-1/2}$，引理 5 完成。
en: Fixes the remaining variance mismatch with Pinsker’s inequality.
TV distance $\lesssim q^{-1/2}$; Lemma 5 done.

zh: 把 $B$ 个比特轮流分给 $d$ 个坐标。
每个坐标约 $B/d$ 比特、约 $n$ 台机器参与。
en: Deals the $B$ bits round-robin to the $d$ coordinates.
Each coordinate gets ≈ $B/d$ bits and ≈ $n$ machines.

zh: 逐项检查编码保证的条件在每个坐标上都成立。
可以放心套用 Cai–Wei 的结论。
en: Checks the encoder’s conditions for each coordinate.
The Cai–Wei result can be applied.

zh: 把编码保证给出的三项，逐一换成天花板 $\mathcal U$ 里的对应项。
大块情形的通信误差 $\lesssim$ 天花板。
en: Converts the encoder’s three terms into the matching terms of the ceiling $\mathcal U$.
In the large-block case, communication error $\lesssim$ the ceiling.

zh: 说明小块情形可以用私有随机性，并概述证明步骤。
路线：一比特测量 → 灵敏度 → 逐级定位 → 精修。
en: Notes that private randomness is allowed and outlines the small-block proof.
Route: one-bit measurements → sensitivity → successive localization → refinement.

zh: 用 1 比特测量二项计数的特征函数（一根“表针”）的实部和虚部。
一比特就能无偏地读出表针位置。
en: Measures the real and imaginary parts of the binomial’s characteristic function (a “clock hand”) with one bit.
One bit reads the hand’s position unbiasedly.

zh: 选一串翻倍的频率，并证明表针长度不会缩成一个点。
最快一级的灵敏度对应单机精度 $1/\sqrt m$。
en: Chooses doubling frequencies and shows the hand never shrinks to a point.
The fastest level’s sensitivity matches single-machine precision $1/\sqrt m$.

zh: 给每一级分配机器做粗测量，并定义“一切顺利”事件。
出错概率很小，粗定位只用很少的机器。
en: Assigns machines to coarse measurements at each level and defines the “all good” event.
Failure is unlikely, and localization uses few machines.

zh: 解码器逐级缩小可行区间：先看时针，再看分针。
每升一级区间缩一半，最后定位到 $1/\sqrt m$ 精度。
en: The decoder shrinks the feasible interval level by level: hour hand, then minute hand.
Each level halves the interval, ending at precision $1/\sqrt m$.
Use fresh machines for a finer estimate at the highest frequency, then decode inside the already localized interval.
Under the small-block allocation conditions, the squared-error guarantee has order $1/(Qm)$ using one-bit messages.
zh: 用新机器在最高频率上做更精确的测量，再在已经定位的区间内解码。
在本节的小样本块与机器分配条件下，一比特消息即可达到 $1/(Qm)$ 量级的平方误差保证。
把引理 6 用到每个坐标（每组约 $n/d$ 台机器）。
小块情形的误差 $\lesssim 1/(nm)$，也在天花板以内。
en: Applies Lemma 6 coordinate by coordinate (≈ $n/d$ machines each).
Small-block error $\lesssim 1/(nm)$, also within the ceiling.
More machines can send more bits, but overlapping data do not create new independent samples. This section explains why counting machines alone gives the wrong picture.
Keep three limits in mind: the number of distinct samples, the total communication budget, and the bits needed to locate the parameter before refining it.
zh: 机器越多，能发送的比特越多；但重复读取同一条样本，并不会增加独立数据。本章先说明为什么不能只按机器数量估算精度。
后面始终围绕三个限制：能看到多少不同样本、总共能传多少比特，以及精细估计前要先花多少比特确定参数的大致位置。

en: This is the map for the rest of the paper: define the experiment, state the assumptions, and display the risk bounds.
Read the model in II-A, separate the two sets of assumptions in II-B, then use II-C and Table I to see where the bounds match.
zh: 本章是全文地图：先把实验规则讲清楚，再列出假设，最后给出误差上下界。
II-A 规定数据与通信方式，II-B 区分上下界各自需要的假设，II-C 和表 I 告诉你哪些情形已经解决。

en: A pool has $N$ observations; each of $n$ machines independently chooses $m$ distinct indices and communicates at most $k$ bits. The center must estimate the same unknown parameter.
The definitions distinguish noninteractive messages from public blackboard interaction. Both obey the total budget $B=nk$, which later limits transcript entropy.
zh: 池中有 $N$ 条观测；$n$ 台机器各自独立抽取 $m$ 个不同编号，每台最多传 $k$ 比特，中心据此估计同一个未知参数。
本节区分一次发送的非交互协议与公开黑板上的交互协议。两者都受总预算 $B=nk$ 限制，后面就用它约束通信记录的熵。

en: The lower bound controls likelihood sensitivity through a regular model and a Bernstein condition on the score. The upper bound instead needs bounded moments that identify the parameter stably.
These assumptions do different jobs. They are needed together when claiming matching upper and lower rates, rather than for every intermediate argument.
zh: 下界需要正则模型与得分的 Bernstein 条件，用来限制数据对参数的敏感度；上界则需要能够稳定反推出参数的有界矩。
两组假设各司其职。只有要宣布上下界同阶时，才需同时满足它们；不能把某一边的假设误当成另一边的前提。

en: The surplus $s$ measures the bits left after coarse localization. The lower and upper envelopes collect the competing sample and communication bottlenecks.
Theorem 1 gives the envelopes; Table I says when they match. The shared-sample correction explains the remaining intermediate-overlap gap.
zh: 余量 $s$ 衡量扣除粗定位成本后还剩多少比特。上下界包络把样本量、访问量和通信量造成的瓶颈合到一起。
定理 1 给出总界，表 I 列出上下界何时一致；下界中的共享样本修正项，则解释了中等重叠区间为何仍有缺口。

en: This chapter proves that every allowed protocol must make a certain amount of error, even with interaction. Its strategy is to upper-bound available information, then convert that into a lower bound on error.
III-A builds the tools; III-B and III-C control private blocks; III-D adds shared observations; III-E combines everything with the bit budget.
zh: 本章证明：任何符合规则的协议，即使允许交互，也不可能把误差无限压低。路线是先限制可获得的信息，再把信息上界转换成误差下界。
III-A 准备工具，III-B、III-C 控制私有样本块，III-D 加入共享观测，III-E 最后与比特预算合并。

en: Processed data inherit the conditional mean of the raw score. This yields information data processing, a chain rule, and a Bayesian inequality connecting information to squared error.
The section then extracts the distinct-sample and bit-budget floors. Its leftover-entropy budget is saved for the harder bound in III-E.
zh: 加工后的数据，其得分等于原始得分的条件均值。由此得到信息的数据处理不等式、链式法则，以及把信息转换成平方误差下界的贝叶斯不等式。
接着先拿到不同样本数量与比特预算给出的简单下界，再留下一个“剩余熵预算”，供 III-E 处理更难的一项。

en: How much can learning an event shift a block score? Lemma 1 turns event rarity into a logarithmic bound on that shift.
Averaging over message events turns the logarithm into entropy. Lemma 2 controls the squared-logarithm correction required by Bernstein tails.
zh: 得知某个事件发生后，样本块得分的均值最多能偏移多少？引理 1 把这种偏移限制在事件稀有程度的对数量级。
对各条消息对应的事件平均，就把对数概率变成熵；Bernstein 尾部多出来的对数平方项，则交给引理 2 控制。

en: Start with independent private blocks and allow the machines to interact. At fixed parameter and seeds, a complete transcript event factors into local input constraints.
That rectangle structure preserves conditional block independence. It lets the proof combine block-score bounds while charging the correction to the whole transcript only once.
zh: 先处理私有样本块相互独立、但机器之间可以交互的情形。固定参数和种子后，一条完整通信记录对应的事件可拆成各机器的局部输入条件。
这一“矩形结构”保留了条件块独立性，使各块得分界能够合并，并且修正项只需对完整通信记录计算一次。

en: Partition the actual observations into a shared group and disjoint private groups. Reveal the shared group in the information comparison, then apply III-C to the remaining private blocks.
The chain rule adds the shared group’s information once. It is not free side information in the communication-entropy budget; keeping those two steps separate is essential.
zh: 把实际观测分成共享组与互不重叠的私有组。在信息比较中先揭示共享组，再对剩余私有块应用 III-C 的结果。
链式法则把共享组的信息计入一次；但在通信熵预算中，不能把它当作免费辅助信息。这两个步骤必须分清。

en: Now assemble the shared-observation information bound, van Trees, and the leftover-entropy budget. The coarse-localization cost cancels, exposing the surplus $s$.
Solve the resulting logarithmic inequality, absorb the Bernstein correction in the appropriate regimes, then combine all risk floors. The Gaussian ending keeps explicit constants.
zh: 现在把共享观测信息界、van Trees 不等式和剩余熵预算拼起来。粗定位成本在合并时抵消，真正起作用的余量 $s$ 随之显现。
接着解对数不等式，在相应情形下吸收 Bernstein 修正，再合并所有误差下限；最后的高斯版本保留显式常数。

en: This chapter constructs a noninteractive protocol to reach the upper envelope. Rather than estimating the parameter directly, it first estimates bounded identifying moments.
The route is exact resampling, Bernoulli randomization, communication-efficient moment estimation, and stable inversion back to the parameter.
zh: 本章构造达到上界包络的非交互协议。先不直接估参数，而是估计能够识别参数的有界矩。
路线依次是：精确重抽样、伯努利随机化、节省通信的矩估计，最后稳定地反推出参数。

en: Local subsets overlap, so using their raw samples as independent blocks would be wrong. The resampling rule produces exactly the required independent draws after averaging over the random access sets.
Conditional on the pool, Bernoulli randomization reduces the task to estimating its empirical moments. This separates communication error from the finite-pool sampling error.
zh: 本地子集存在重叠，不能直接把原始数据当成独立样本块。这里设计的重抽样规则，在对随机访问集平均后，精确地产生所需的独立抽取。
给定样本池，再用伯努利随机化把任务化为估计池中的经验矩，从而将通信误差与有限样本池的抽样误差分开。

en: When local blocks are large, smooth a binomial statistic with Gaussian noise so it meets a robust scalar encoder’s input conditions.
The proof checks bias, concentration and total variation carefully, allocates bits across coordinates, and translates the encoder’s bound into the upper envelope.
zh: 本地样本块较大时，给二项统计量加入高斯噪声，使它满足稳健标量编码器的输入条件。
证明先核对无偏性、集中性和全变差距离，再按坐标分配比特，最后把编码器的误差界转换为论文的上界包络。

en: For small blocks, use a direct one-bit construction instead of the Gaussian approximation. Bits estimate the real and imaginary parts of a characteristic function.
Increasing frequencies act like progressively finer clock hands: first locate the parameter, then refine it with fresh machines under this section’s allocation conditions.
zh: 小样本块改用直接的一比特构造，不走高斯近似。发送的比特用来估计特征函数的实部与虚部。
逐渐升高的频率像越来越精细的钟表指针：先确定参数所在区间，再在本节的机器分配条件下，用新机器精修。

en: The preceding sections estimate the empirical moments. Clip those estimates and choose a parameter whose moment vector is nearest to them.
The inverse-Lipschitz assumption converts moment error into parameter error. Adding the finite-pool error completes the noninteractive upper bound.
zh: 前面已经估出了经验矩。本节先截断这些估计，再选择矩向量与它们最接近的参数。
逆 Lipschitz 假设把矩误差转换为参数误差；加上有限样本池的误差，就完成非交互上界的证明。

en: The abstract theorem becomes useful only after checking its two assumptions in real models. This chapter supplies those checks, starting with how fixed affine reparameterization changes constants.
Bounded scores lead to sub-Gaussian examples; unbounded scores motivate the broader Bernstein condition. Bounded identifying moments provide the matching construction.
zh: 抽象定理要能用，必须在具体模型中验证两组假设。本章逐一核对，并先说明固定仿射重参数化为何只改变常数。
得分有界时可走次高斯路线；得分无界时，较宽的 Bernstein 条件就派上用场。有界识别矩则为相应的上界构造提供入口。

en: Gaussian means give the cleanest running example: the score is Gaussian, while threshold indicators give bounded moments that identify the mean.
The bounded-score criterion then covers Bernoulli and multinomial models on parameter regions kept away from degenerate probabilities.
zh: 高斯均值是最直观的例子：得分本身为高斯，阈值指示函数则给出能够识别均值的有界矩。
随后利用有界得分准则，处理参数远离退化概率的伯努利模型与多项分布模型。

en: In bounded-statistic exponential families, the score is a centered sufficient statistic. A uniform covariance lower bound makes its mean informative enough to invert.
Logistic regression follows a similar route with bounded covariates and a nondegenerate second-moment matrix. These conditions verify the theorem rather than define a new protocol.
zh: 对统计量有界的指数族，得分就是中心化的充分统计量；一致的协方差下界保证其均值包含足够信息，可以稳定反演。
逻辑回归采用相近思路，使用有界协变量与非退化二阶矩矩阵。这些条件是在验证已有定理，而非另造一套协议。

en: Poisson and exponential scores are unbounded, so a bounded-score argument is unavailable. Their moment-generating functions still satisfy a Bernstein bound near zero.
Fixed event indicators provide bounded identifying moments on compact parameter intervals. This shows why allowing $b>0$ expands the theorem’s scope.
zh: 泊松与指数分布的得分无界，不能直接套用有界得分论证；但它们的矩母函数在零附近仍满足 Bernstein 界。
在固定的紧参数区间内，用事件指示函数即可构造有界识别矩。这说明允许 $b>0$ 能把定理扩展到哪些模型。

en: Here the parameter is a covariance matrix, and each directional score is a Gaussian quadratic form. Its tails require the Bernstein version of the theorem.
Bounded functions of directional projections identify the directional variances; a suitable collection of directions then recovers the covariance matrix.
zh: 这里要估计的是协方差矩阵，各方向得分为高斯二次型，因此需要定理的 Bernstein 版本来控制尾部。
方向投影的有界函数可以识别对应方向的方差；选取合适的一组方向，就能恢复整个协方差矩阵。

en: The resolved regimes are summarized, then the remaining intermediate-overlap window is isolated. The lower envelope contains a shared-sample correction that the current upper envelope lacks.
Closing the gap requires either a stronger information bound or a construction that exploits overlap better. Even Gaussian mean estimation still leaves this question open.
zh: 本章汇总已经解决的情形，并指出尚未解决的中等重叠窗口：当前下界包络含有共享样本修正，而上界包络没有对应项。
缩小这一缺口，需要更强的信息界，或更善于利用重叠的构造；即使只考虑高斯均值，问题也仍未解决。

en: A vanishing fraction of repeated accesses is much weaker than having no collisions at all. Pairwise overlap counting distinguishes these two claims.
Neither alone transfers an exponentially small risk through coupling: the coupling failure probability must be smaller than the target error scale, not merely tend to zero.
zh: 重复访问比例趋于零，远弱于完全没有碰撞。通过计算成对访问集的重叠，本附录把这两个说法区分开。
二者本身都不足以通过耦合转移指数小的风险：耦合失败概率必须小于目标误差量级，仅仅趋于零还不够。

en: These are the external results supporting the proof: communication lower bounds, robust distributed encoders, Bayesian information inequalities, and concentration tools.
Use the citation numbers in the main text to trace an imported result back to its source; the paper’s own numbered equations remain above.
zh: 这里列出证明借用的外部结果，包括通信下界、稳健分布式编码、贝叶斯信息不等式与集中性工具。
正文中的引用编号可帮助追溯某条外部结论的来源；本文自己的公式编号则保留在前面的正文中。
